---
title: "JOLTS_harmonize"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# Inspect JOLTS Industry-Level Stability Data
# ============================================================

# Load annual JOLTS data
jolts_turnover <- read_csv(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_industry_annual_2000_2024.csv"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Basic structure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

glimpse(jolts_turnover)

dim(jolts_turnover)

jolts_turnover
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Inspect the data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    industry_code,
    element_code
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Industry coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  distinct(
    industry_code,
    industry
  ) %>%
  arrange(industry_code)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Year coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = min(year),
    last_year = max(year),
    n_years = n_distinct(year)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Number of observations by measure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  count(
    element_code,
    measure
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Observations per industry
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  count(
    industry_code,
    industry
  ) %>%
  arrange(industry_code)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Check for duplicate industry-year-measure observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  count(
    year,
    industry_code,
    element_code
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Check for missing rates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_missing_rates =
      sum(is.na(separation_rate))
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Identify industry-years with incomplete coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_turnover %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    industry_code,
    industry
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_measures = n_distinct(element_code),
    measures = paste(
      sort(unique(measure)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_measures < 3
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    industry_code
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Create a clean primary stability measure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_stability <- jolts_turnover %>%
  filter(
    measure == "Layoffs and discharges rate"
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    industry_code,
    industry,
    layoffs_discharge_rate = separation_rate
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    industry_code
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Check primary stability measure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_stability %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry_code),
    first_year = min(year),
    last_year = max(year),
    missing_rate =
      sum(is.na(layoffs_discharge_rate))
  )


# Confirm one row per industry-year
jolts_stability %>%
  count(
    year,
    industry_code
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# ============================================================
# Add reverse-coded JOLTS stability measure
# ============================================================

jolts_stability <- jolts_stability %>%
  mutate(
    stability_reverse =
      -layoffs_discharge_rate
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check the new measure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_stability %>%
  select(
    year,
    industry_code,
    industry,
    layoffs_discharge_rate,
    stability_reverse
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Verify the reverse coding
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jolts_stability %>%
  summarise(
    min_layoffs = min(
      layoffs_discharge_rate,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_layoffs = max(
      layoffs_discharge_rate,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_stability = min(
      stability_reverse,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_stability = max(
      stability_reverse,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save the updated primary stability dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  jolts_stability,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_stability_industry_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  jolts_stability,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_stability_industry_2000_2024.csv"
  )
)

```
